The values for align are: "left" means that the text is left justified (quad flush left) "right" means that the text is right justified (quad flush right) "center" means that the text is center justified (text is centered around the middle of the column) "justify" means that the text is justified (both quad left and right) "char" means that text is aligned to the leftmost occurrence of the value of the attribute char value. When the attribute align is set to "char", attributes char and charoff must be used. The attribute char is the single character that is used to align the text. The most common use is to align on a '.' (a full stop, or period) for decimal alignment of a column of numbers as shown in Fig 1:
attribute.title: Table group

attribute.name: changeMark
attribute.definition:
indicates whether the display of a change bar, mark or other visual indication next to the entire content of an element being added, deleted or modified is intended. The attribute can have one of the following values:
- "1" - Yes, the display of a change bar, mark or other visual indication is intended
- "0" - No, the display of a change bar, mark or other visual indication is not intended
Note
If the attribute changeMark is not used, then there is no display of a change bar, mark or other visual indication intended.

attribute.name: changeType
attribute.definition:
the type of the change. The attribute can have one of the following values:
- "add" - the element is added
- "modify" - the element is changed
- "delete" - the element is deleted
Note
The attribute changeType can apply to any element and not especially to the element where the change occurs. Depending on the type of the change, propagation rules defining the change marking inheritance from the upper element to the lower can differ:
- Elements marked with the value “modify” are allowed to contain elements marked with values “add”, “modify” or “delete”
- Elements marked with the value “delete”: There is no need to set the change attributes on the element’s children because this is implied. Any change markings on child elements are ignored by the presentation system.
- Elements marked with value “add”: There is no need to set the change attributes on the element’s children because this is implied. Any change markings on child elements are ignored by the presentation system.
Note
If this attribute is not used, and the attribute changeMark is used, the change is assumed to be an addition.

attribute.name: colwidth
attribute.definition: is the column width setting. Column width can be specified using either ar proportional measure, a fixed measure, or a mixed measure. A proportional measure is of the form "number*" (eg 10*), and means that the column width is the number times the proportion. A fixed measure is of the form number and unit (eg 25pt, 25mm, 16.2in). The units are case insensitive and can be "pt" (points), "cm" (centimeters), "mm" (millimeters), "pi" (picas), and "in" (inches). The default fixed unit should be interpreted as "pt" if neither a proportion nor a fixed unit is specified. An example of a mixed measure is 10*+3pt. If no column width is specified for a column specification, this implies that the column has the proportional width "1*", and hence, if no column widths are specified for any column, the column widths will be the same for each column and will be an equal proportion of the available width.

attribute.name: issueType
attribute.definition: This attribute gives the issue status of the data module. There are eight values that can be used. "new". Data modules up to and including the initial issue of the approved release must have the attribute issueNumber set to the value "000" for inwork versions or value "001" for the initial issue and have the attribute issueType set to the value "new". "deleted". Deletion of data modules is treated as a special case of update. The data module, itself is not physically deleted from the CSDB but marked as deleted by setting the attribute issueType to the value "deleted". "changed". Data modules that have been changed and have the changes indicated within the data module using change elements and attributes, must have the attribute issueType set to the value "changed". "revised". Data modules that have been totally revised and that contain no change elements or attributes must have the attribute issueType set to the value "revised". "status". Data modules that have had their identification and status information updated must have the attribute issueType set to the value "status". "rinstate-status". Data modules that have been reinstated from a previously deleted data module and have only the status information changed must have the attribute issueType set to the value "rinstate-status". In the simplest case, this status change must require setting the attribute issueType to the value "rinstate-status". "rinstate-changed". Data modules that have been reinstated from a previously deleted data module and have the changes indicated by change elements and attributes, must have the attribute issueType set to the value "rinstate-changed". "rinstate-revised". Data modules that have been reinstated from a previously deleted data module and have the changes not indicated by change elements and attributes, must have the attribute issueType set to the value "rinstate-revised".

"embedInContext" will display the linked data inline at the point where the dmRef occurred. This is useful when you have data that can be used verbatim in several data modules and maintained in a separate data module to itself. "replaceAndReturnToSource" will replace the current screen of data with the dmRef data and then return the user to the origin of the dmRef when he presses Next to continue. "replaceAndNoReturn" will replace the current screen of data with the dmRef data and not provide a Next option. "replaceAndNoReturn" conceptually breaks the connection with the referencing data. attribute.title: Table entry

attribute.name: rowsep
attribute.definition: Para 2.1.2. This attribute is used to display rules below the row to which it applies. A rowsep that is set on a <captionEntry> element determines if a rule is drawn for the width of the entry only. A non-zero value for this attribute will draw a rule. If the rowsep attribute is not used, it implies that a column rule will not be drawn.
attribute.title: Caption entry

attribute.name: rulesContext
attribute.definition: specifies the context to which the contained rules apply. Context must be specified by the applicable URL of the Schema for XML encoded CSDB objects, eg http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-0/xml_schema_master/dm/descriptSchema.xsd.
attribute.title: Context related rules

attribute.name: runTimeDuration
attribute.definition: defines the objects run time (this can be necessary for text to sound synchronization, common in e-learning).
attribute.title: Multimedia Object

attribute.name: safeFlight
attribute.definition: indicates the equipment is safe for flight.
attribute.title: Check list procedure

attribute.name: safetyCategoryValue
attribute.definition: specifies the supply requirement safety category. This attribute can have one of the following values: "A" for supply requirement alternatives mandatory for safety reasons "B" for recommended supply requirement alternatives "C" for commonly supply requirement alternatives
attribute.title: Category

attribute.name: safetyLabel
attribute.definition: must contain a short description of the type of safety issue or a category selected from industry standard safety labels.
attribute.title: Product safety

attribute.name: scoCodingScheme
attribute.definition: no definition available
attribute.title: scoCodingScheme

attribute.name: scoEntryType
attribute.definition: the type of SCO entry
attribute.title: SCO Entry

attribute.name: scoMediaCode
attribute.definition: Media identification (label).
attribute.title: SCO media

attribute.name: scoMediaType
attribute.definition: Media type (eg paper, CD-ROM, DVD, online).
attribute.title: SCO media

attribute.name: scormContentPackageIssuer
attribute.definition: The issuing authority is applicable in the publication module code and SCORM module code to the characters identified as follows: YY - YYYYY - YYYYY - NN (14 characters) thru YYYYYYYYYYYYYY - YYYYY - YYYYY - NN (26 characters) To identify the issuing authority it is recommended to use the CAGE code. The role, responsibility and identification must be defined in the project business rules.
attribute.title: SCORM content package code

attribute.name: scormContentPackageMediaCode
attribute.definition: Media identification (label)
attribute.title: SCORM content package media

attribute.name: scormContentPackageMediaType
attribute.definition: Media type (eg paper, CD-ROM, DVD, online)
attribute.title: SCORM content package media

attribute.name: screenLevel
attribute.definition: describes the physical level of the screen in a shielding situation. Outer screens (over all screens) must have higher values than inner screens (screens of cables)
attribute.title: Screen/shield information

attribute.name: screenStyle
attribute.definition: describes the style for the graphical presentation of the screen in a shielding situation
attribute.title: Screen/shield information

attribute.name: screenType
attribute.definition: describes the type of the wire in a shielding situation Note The attribute screenType describes the connection type of a wire (normally on both ends of the screen, a wire is connected to, eg pin screens), connected to this screen or the shielded wire itself. Screen information for the complete screen is provided in the element <wireInfo>. Therefore it is recommended not to use the screen type attribute screenType in this context.
attribute.title: Screen/shield information

attribute.name: securityClassification
attribute.definition: This attribute has possible integer values from "01" thru "99". The meaning of the value is defined by the project with the lowest classification being "01". The classification must correspond to the highest classification of the individual elements within the data module content. For the definition of the possible values, refer to Chap 3.9.6.1.
attribute.title: Security classification

attribute.name: selectOrManufactureValue
attribute.definition: is used to store this information and is set
attribute.title: Select or manufacture from identifier

attribute.name: senderIdent
attribute.definition: contains the CAGE code of the sender of the comment
attribute.title: Dispatch note identification code

attribute.name: separatorStyle
attribute.definition: used to indicate the separator characters between a challenge and a response. This attribute can have one of the following values: "dot" to indicate a sequence of dots "line" to indicate a line "none" to indicate no separator
attribute.title: Crew drill step

attribute.name: seqNumber
attribute.definition: contains a sequence number of the comment, related to senderIdent and yearOfDateIssue
attribute.title: Dispatch note identification code

attribute.name: serialNumberForm
attribute.definition: the is used to specify if the serial number is a single value or a range of values. This attribute can have the following values: "single", specifies a single value "range", specifies a range of values
attribute.title: Serial number

attribute.name: serialNumberValue
attribute.definition: the single value or the range of values. A tilde [~] is used to separate the two values. For example, LKJ123~LKJ777.

attribute.name: setAction
attribute.definition: Functions on a single expression

attribute.name: setOperation
attribute.definition: Operations between two expressions

attribute.name: show
attribute.definition: xlink

attribute.name: showPluginControls
attribute.definition: used to hide or show the third party software plug-in controls. This attribute can have the following values: "hide" to hide the plug-in controls "show" to show the plug-in controls
attribute.title: Multimedia Object

attribute.name: significantParaDataType
attribute.definition: the meaning of the data. This attribute can have the following values: "psd01" - "psd99".
attribute.title: Paragraph significant data

attribute.name: skillLevelCode
attribute.definition: the skill level of the person. The attribute can have the following values: "sk01" thru "sk99".
attribute.title: Skill level

attribute.name: skillType
attribute.definition: this attribute provides a classification of the main technical ability required of the person performing the task (eg "Airframe", "Electrical", "Avionic", "Engine") and must be populated as described in Chap 3.9.6.1.
attribute.title: Task definition

attribute.name: sleeveMaterial
attribute.definition: indicates the material of which the sleeve is made
attribute.title: Harness sleeve information

attribute.name: sourceCriticality
attribute.definition: this attribute is a four character value with the pattern of "sc" plus two digits that indicates the impact of not complying with the requirement (refer to Chap 3.9.6.1 for the list of values). It is also called the failure effect category. As an example, the values for civil air given by: "sc5" = "Evident, safety", "sc6" = "Evident, Operational", "sc7" = "Evident, Economic", "sc8" = "Hidden, Safety", "sc9" = "Hidden, Non-Safety" and an empty string indicates "not coming from MSG3.
attribute.title: Source type

attribute.name: sourceIdent
attribute.definition: this attribute contains the document number of the source of requirement or the title of the source if no document number is available.
attribute.title: Requirement source

attribute.name: sourceOfRqmt
attribute.definition: this attribute contains a code that indicates the origination of the requirement (eg "MSG3", "CMR" and "AD")
attribute.title: Requirement source

attribute.name: sourceTypeCode
attribute.definition: a five character value with the pattern of "stc" plus two digits that indicates the type of source
attribute.title: Source type

attribute.name: spanname
attribute.definition: this attribute is a named, reusable span specification for merged <captionEntry> elements. The value must be the name of a span defined in a <spanspec> element in the current <captionGroup>
attribute.title: Caption entry

attribute.name: sparePartClassCode
attribute.definition: specifies whether the spare part class code of the part. This attribute can have one of the following values: "0" for non-procurable parts "1" for expandable parts "2" for rotable parts "6" for repairable parts
attribute.title: Spare part class code

attribute.name: specDocumentNumber
attribute.definition: the identifier number of the specification or drawing.
attribute.title: Specification

attribute.name: specDocumentType
attribute.definition: the type of the specification (drawing or standard)
attribute.title: Specification

attribute.name: specialLabelFlag
attribute.definition: a flag to indicate that the supply product has a special labeling or not. This attribute can have one of the following values: "1" (yes) for supplies with special labeling "0" (no) for supplies without special labeling
attribute.title: Supply specification

attribute.name: specific
attribute.definition: the indicator if it is a standard or a specific tool. This attribute can have the following values: "1" (D) - indicates it is a standard tool "0" - all tools that are not specific to the Product, and that are not a "common tool" (standard hand tool), ie it comprises mainly test equipments such as voltmeter or signal generators, but also ladders, platforms, torque wrench with particular value range, etc.
attribute.title: Tool reference

attribute.name: startupDuration
attribute.definition: the duration for performing Preliminary requirements
attribute.title: Maintenance task duration

attribute.name: stepLabel
attribute.definition: used to identify the label of the step
attribute.title: Crew drill step

attribute.name: stringAction
attribute.definition: Functions on a single expression

attribute.name: stringOperation
attribute.definition: Operations between two expressions

attribute.name: subCategory
attribute.definition: the subcategory of the fault part of the correlation
attribute.title: Warning or malfunction

attribute.name: subSubSystemCode
attribute.definition: the sub-subsystem code (part of the SNS).
attribute.title: Data module code

attribute.name: subSystemCode
attribute.definition: the subsystem code (part of the SNS).
attribute.title: Data module code

attribute.name: submitCaption
attribute.definition: indicates caption used for the submit function push button. This attribute can have one of the following values: "ok01" (D), sets the caption as "OK" "ok02" sets the caption as "SUBMIT" "ok03" sets the caption as "YES" "ok04" sets the caption as "CONTINUE" "ok05" sets the caption as "EXIT" "ok06" thru "ok50" reserved for future S1000D use "ok51" thru "ok99" sets the caption with project specific captions
attribute.title: Dialog

attribute.name: supervisorLevelCode
attribute.definition: identifies if either the supervisor must observe the task or inspect the results of the task.
attribute.title: Supervisor level

attribute.name: supplyNumber
attribute.definition: the supply number, which can be the supply trade name or a specification number
attribute.title: Supply identifier

attribute.name: supplyNumberType
attribute.definition: indicates whether the supply number is a trade name or a specification. This attribute can have one of the following values: "comref" for supply number corresponding to the supply trade name "spec" when the supply number corresponds to a specification number
attribute.title: Supply identifier

attribute.name: supplyRqmtNumber
attribute.definition: the supply requirement number.
attribute.title: Supply requirement identifier

attribute.name: supplyRqmtType
attribute.definition: the type of the supply requirement alternative
attribute.title: Alternatives of the supply requirement

attribute.name: systemCode
attribute.definition: the system code (part of the SNS).
attribute.title: Data module code

attribute.name: systemDiffCode
attribute.definition: the system difference code.
attribute.title: Data module code

attribute.name: systemIdentCode
attribute.definition: the system identification code as defined by the project
attribute.title: Captions

attribute.name: tableOfContentType
attribute.definition: is used when generating Caption color based Tables of Contents, or color TOCs. This attribute can have one of the following values: "none"(D) "redtoc" "comdtoc" "ambertoc" "greentoc" "yelowtoc".
attribute.title: Captions

attribute.name: tabstyle
attribute.definition: defines a style for the table. Although the CALS table model allows the value of this attribute to determine the presentation style of the table (in terms of the table rulings, the frame, the orientation etc), S1000D mandates that the presentation attributes are populated with the correct values to make the table display correctly in any application. This attribute must not be used for tables that only contain a graphic (refer to Para 2.2).
attribute.title: Table markup

attribute.name: targetTitle
attribute.definition: used to provide a human-readable label for the link destination, which could be presented after the target identifier (eg "Hub function") or be displayed when for instance the cursor is hovering over the target identifier.
attribute.title: General

attribute.name: taskCategoryCode
attribute.definition: the tool task category value.
attribute.title: Task code

attribute.name: taskCode
attribute.definition: this attribute provides a mechanism to categorize the task. For example, a general visual inspection is a common category. The valid pattern for this attribute is "taskcd" plus two digits. Several task code values are defined in Chap 3.9.6.1. The project or the organization must decide additional definitions.
attribute.title: Task definition

attribute.name: taskIdent
attribute.definition: identifies the task that has an association to the current task
attribute.title: Related task

attribute.name: taskName
attribute.definition: this attribute contains the textual identifier of the task
attribute.title: Task item

attribute.name: taskSeqNumber
attribute.definition: this attribute contains the ordinal position of the task within the inspection tasks group
attribute.title: Task item

attribute.name: testCode
attribute.definition: the code for test
attribute.title: Fault isolation test performance

attribute.name: testType
attribute.definition: the name of the type of test
attribute.title: Fault isolation test performance

attribute.name: textDisplayPosition
attribute.definition: which indicates the text display placement in relationship to the data entry or selection. If the attribute is not used, the IETP implies the text is positioned above for a user menu question, left for a userEntry question, and right for menu choice text. "top" - The prompt is positioned above the data entry information "bottom" - The prompt is positioned below the data entry information "right" - The prompt is positioned right of the data entry information "left" - The prompt is positioned left of the data entry information.
attribute.title: User prompts

attribute.name: tgstyle
attribute.definition: the table group style. This defines that a specified style (eg column and row specifications) is to be applied to the table group. Although the CALS table model allows the value of this attribute to determine the presentation style of the table (in terms of the table rulings, the frame, the orientation etc), S1000D mandates that the presentation attributes are populated with the correct values to make the table display correctly in any application.
attribute.title: Table group

attribute.name: thresholdType
attribute.definition: This attribute contains the value "threshold" or "interval", and it specifies the starting point of the threshold. It can be "from the beginning" of the maintenance program or from "the last time the inspection was performed."
attribute.title: Threshold information

attribute.name: thresholdUnitOfMeasure
attribute.definition: the unit of measurement for the threshold interval. This attribute can have the following values: "th01" thru "th99".
attribute.title: Threshold interval

attribute.name: timeLimitCategoryValue
attribute.definition: an enumeration representing the categories of time limits. Valid values are "1" and "2". These values can represent categories such as "safety related" or "non-safety related".
attribute.title: Time limit category

attribute.name: timeLimitIdent
attribute.definition: this attribute gives the identifier of the <timeLimit> element.
attribute.title: Time limit information

attribute.name: title
attribute.definition: xlink

attribute.name: to
attribute.definition: the end value for a range of values
attribute.title: Test parameters

attribute.name: to
attribute.definition: the end value for a range of values
attribute.title: Test parameters

attribute.name: tocentry
attribute.definition: determines whether the table will appear in the list of tables. If the value of this attribute is "0," the table’s title will not appear in the automatically generated list of tables at the front of the data module. If the value is not "0," or the attribute is not used, and the table has a title, it will appear in the list of tables. If the table has a title and you do not wish it to appear in the list of tables, you must specify a tocentry value of "0."
attribute.title: Table markup

attribute.name: toleranceHigh
attribute.definition: this attribute gives the positive threshold value tolerance (+ n)
attribute.title: Tolerance information

attribute.name: toleranceLow
attribute.definition: this attribute gives the negative threshold value tolerance (- n)
attribute.title: Tolerance information

attribute.name: toolAltFlag
attribute.definition: the indicator if the tool is an alternative of the previously described tool. This attribute can have the following values: "0" (D) - indicates that it is not an alternate tool "1" - indicates that it is an alternate tool
attribute.title: Tool reference

attribute.name: toolNumber
attribute.definition: the tool part number.
attribute.title: Tool identifier

attribute.name: toolRefType
attribute.definition: the type of the relationship between the tools (eg symmetry, replacement relationship).
attribute.title: Relationships with others tools

attribute.name: twistingType
attribute.definition: specifies the type of twisting
attribute.title: Twist information

attribute.name: type
attribute.definition: xlink

attribute.name: unitOfMeasure
attribute.definition: the unit of measure
attribute.title: Maintenance task duration

attribute.name: updateHighlight
attribute.definition: if this attribute is set to the value "1", this indicates that the reason for update must appear in the highlights data module. If the attribute is not used or its value is "0", it means that the reason for update must not appear in the highlights data module.
attribute.title: The reason for update

attribute.name: updateReasonType
attribute.definition: this attribute is used to indicate the type of the reason for update that it applies to, and us a configurable attribute (refer to Chap 3.9.6.1). If this attribute is not used, it implies that the change type is technical. The values that follow are predefined in S1000D: "urt01", this value means that the changes are editorial (and therefore there must be no change markers in the data module that relate to this reason for update). There must be no technical changes in a data module that has this value set. "urt02", this value means that the changes are technical, and provided that the data module is not totally revised (refer to Chap 3.9.5.1), there must be change markers that relate to this reason for update. "urt03", this means that the changes are related to mark up only and if these changes affect the technical content of the data module, and the data module is of issue type changed, the changes that relate to this reason for update must be marked. "urt04", this means that the changes are to applicability markings only and if these changes do not affect the technical content (or the issue type is not changed), then there must be no change markings in the data module that relate to this reason for update.
attribute.title: The reason for update

attribute.name: valign
attribute.definition: Sets the vertical alignment of the contents of each <captionEntry>, unless overridden by the attribute valign on element <captionEntry>. The valign attribute’s value defines the vertical position of a caption within its <captionEntry>, it does not affect the alignment of the text within a caption. This attribute can have one of the following values: "top" (D), "bottom" , "middle".
attribute.title: Caption body

attribute.name: valueAllowed
attribute.definition: contains the specification for the single value, range of values or pattern value applicable to the object. A range should be specified in the format defined in Chap 3.9.5.3. A pattern should be provided as a regular expression
attribute.title: Object value

attribute.name: valueForm
attribute.definition: specifies the type of content contained in the attribute valueAllowed and can have the following values: "single", which specifies that a single value applies to the object. "range", which specifies that a range of values applies to the object. "pattern", which specifies that a pattern value applies to the object.
attribute.title: Object value

attribute.name: valuePattern
attribute.definition: a pattern specifying the allowable structure for each value in the attribute applicPropertyValues in the element <enumeration>. The pattern follows the XML schema regular expression rules as specified in REC-xmlschema-2-20041-28 W3C Recommendation: XML Schema Part 2: Datatypes Second Edition (2004 Second Edition).
attribute.title: Product attribute

attribute.name: valuePrecision
attribute.definition: the precision of real type data.
attribute.title: Variables

attribute.name: valueType
attribute.definition: "boolean" — Boolean values are TRUE or FALSE "string" — String values are alphanumeric "integer" (D) — Integer values are numeric and contain no decimal point "real" — Real values are numeric and contain a decimal point "set-string", "set-real", or "set-integer" — Set variable represents an unordered list of like values: string, real, or integer.
attribute.title: Variables

attribute.name: variableDescr
attribute.definition: a human readable description of the variable. Often the variable name is not descriptive enough. The description is not normally seen by the end user.
attribute.title: Variables

attribute.name: variableName
attribute.definition: name of variable identified by element <variableRef>
attribute.title: Variable reference

attribute.name: variableScope
attribute.definition: scope of the variable "global" (D) — scope is for the entire user session. "Global" is the only scope currently supported.
attribute.title: Variables

attribute.name: vendorFlag
attribute.definition: a flag to indicate if the list is defined by the Product manufacturer or by a supplier. This attribute can have one of the following values: "1" for a list defined by the Product manufacturer "0" for a list defined by a supplier
attribute.title: Specification list

attribute.name: verbatimStyle
attribute.definition: the style of verbatim text in the cases where there are more than one type of verbatim information and the types should be recognized and/or presented differently. This attribute can have the following values: "vs01" - "vs99", refer to Chap 3.9.6.1
attribute.title: Verbatim text

attribute.name: verificationType
attribute.definition: This attribute can have one of the following values: "onobject", used to indicate that the first verification was carried out at the Product "tabtop", used to indicate that the first verification was carried out on a desktop "ttandoo", used to indicate that the first verification was carried out at the Product and on a desktop
attribute.title: First verification

attribute.name: visibility
attribute.definition: is set to value "hidden" to turn off any graphical regions that are not be displayed for the current use of a graphic, otherwise the value is assumed to be "visible" Note Summary of visibility/interactivity values for a graphical region: visible, not selectable: Do not define in a hotspot, ie do nothing, or Define a hotspot without any internal references, data module references, or CSN references, or Define a hotspot without any internal references, data module references, or CSN references and attribute visibility="visible" visible, selectable: Define a hotspot with at least one internal references, data module references, or CSN reference, or Define a hotspot with at least internal references, data module references, or CSN reference and attribute visibility="visible" not visible, not selectable: Define a hotspot with no internal references, data module references, or CSN references and attribute visibility="hidden" not visible, selectable: Disallowed
attribute.title: Hotspot

attribute.name: vitalWarningFlag
attribute.definition: indicates whether the warning is vital or not. This attribute can have the following values: "0" - a non-vital warning "1" - a vital warning Note It is not recommended to use the attribute vitalWarningFlag as it gives a classification to the warnings and thus can interfere with country legislations and rules.
attribute.title: Warnings

attribute.name: volumeNumber
attribute.definition:
the identifier of the volume of the media, defined by two numeric characters. It is used when the information needs to be separated into several volumes due to media restrictions.
Note
for publications: It is not related to the attribute pmVolume within the publication module code..
Note
for SCORM packages: It must correspond with the element <scormContentPackageVolume> within the SCORM module code.

attribute.name: warningRefs
attribute.definition: the warning reference to the warnings and cautions collection.
attribute.title: Procedural step

attribute.name: warningType
attribute.definition: describes the type of warning
attribute.title: Warnings

attribute.name: wireGaugeType
attribute.definition:
the type of measure for the wire gauge. The attribute wireGaugeType can have one of the following values:
- "proj" - for wires which gauge type is measured in a project or an organization specific unit
- "awg" - for wires which gauge type is measured in accordance with the American Wire Gauge units
- "mt" - for wires which gauge type is measured in a metric unit

attribute.name: wireInstallationDirection
attribute.definition: contains direction information for non-symmetric wires
attribute.title: Contact identification

attribute.name: wireLengthType
attribute.definition: the type of wire length information. The following values are available: "critical", indicates that the new wire must have exactly this defined length when a wire change is performed. Otherwise, the data delivered through the wire will not be accurate "estimated", indicates that the wire length corresponds with the cut length without any constraints to the final length (after installation of the wire) "final", indicates that the wire length corresponds with the length after installation of the wire
attribute.title: Length information

attribute.name: wireState
attribute.definition: the electrical state of a wire. Normally, wires are divided into physical electrical wires and logical connections, eg the connection of a circuit breaker to the bus bar by a screw. This attribute can have only one of the following values: "active" for wires which are active in one of the systems circuits "stowed" for wires which are stowed (not connected) at least on one end "pigtail" for wires which are connected only at one end to an equipment of the system for measurement purposes "notactiv" for wires which are not active in one of the systems circuits "logconn" for electrical connections in one of the systems circuits which are not realized by a physical wire or do not have wire identification (in some cases called flying leads)
attribute.title: Element <wire> and child elements

attribute.name: worthinessLimit
attribute.definition: this attribute signifies whether the task is subject to worthiness limitations. It indicates whether the performance of the tasks is mandatory or recommended.
attribute.title: Task definition

attribute.name: xPath
attribute.definition: no definition available
attribute.title: xPath

attribute.name: year
attribute.definition: A four digit number, which is the year of issue.
attribute.title: Issue date

attribute.name: yearOfDataIssue
attribute.definition: the year (YYYY) when the issue was raised

attribute.name: zoneNumber
attribute.definition: the zone identifier
attribute.title: Zone

attribute.name: zoneRefType
attribute.definition: the type of the relationship between the two zones
attribute.title: References to other zones

attribute.name: zoneSideValue
attribute.definition: the side of the Product where the zone is located. This attribute can have one of the following values: "lh" for a zone located on the left side of the Product "rh" for a zone located on the right side of the Product "lr" when the zone is not located on one side of the Product
attribute.title: Zone side

attribute.name: zoneType
attribute.definition:
the type of the zone. The attribute can have one of the following values:
- "majorzone" - for a major structural area of the Product
- "subzone" - for a subdivision of a major structural area of the Product
- "specifzone" - for a specific zone of the Product
